title: Makegood Remedy
description: Remedy types available when a performance standard or billing measurement threshold is breached.

enumDescriptions.additional_delivery: Seller extends or adds impressions to compensate for the shortfall. Delivery is like-for-like on the same campaign or a subsequent campaign within the same account. A seller advertising media_buy.reporting_subscriptions delivers it only inside a buy's flight: it extends end_time before delivering past the buy's stop time, or delivers on a subsequent buy (reporting-subscription.json delivery_within_flight).
enumDescriptions.credit: Seller issues a credit toward future media buys on the same account.
enumDescriptions.invoice_adjustment: Seller reduces the invoice for the current media buy to reflect actual delivered value.
